blurb: Aspen Helicopters operates helicopters and fixed-wing airplanes for executive charters, aerial firefighting, external load operations, LIDAR mapping, marine animal surveys, and agricultural aerial applications. They have a fleet including Bell helicopters, Partenavia airplanes, and a Fairchild Merlin IIIB. They also operate a FAA Part 145 Repair Station at Oxnard Airport.
extraNote: A three flight hour minimum per day may apply for executive charters · Aircraft/crew standby time charged at 10% of flight rate per crew member · Overnight per diem rates charged based on locale per government GSA per diem portal · Fuel surcharge may apply due to extreme fluctuations in fuel prices · 2899 West 5th Street, Oxnard, CA
